title: Kawali 5
text_content: Southeast Asian epigraph Kawali 5  saṁ hyiṁ liṁga biṁba The sacred liṅga of Bingba (or Bimba). This raises questions both about the meaning of liṅga , and about the history of usage of the panyecek , which would thus stand for /m/ (rather than usual /ŋ/).
